text:
AUG 26 is lit onchain.

4 pieces carry this date, held by 3 wallets. Today 4 USDG is waiting for them.

In 1938 WQXR became the first radio station to broadcast a program using a tape recorder. That choice turned ephemeral airwaves into something you could keep.

AUG 27 is lit onchain.

4 pieces carry this date, held by 3 wallets. Today 4 USDG is waiting for them.

In 1883 Krakatoa exploded with the loudest sound ever recorded, heard 3000 miles away. Days like this remind us some forces leave marks nothing erases.

AUG 28 is lit onchain.

3 pieces carry this date, held by 2 wallets.

In 1963 Martin Luther King delivered the I Have a Dream speech. Its cadence still echoes because the promise it named remains unfinished.

AUG 29 is lit onchain.

10 pieces carry this date, held by 6 wallets. Today 10 USDG is waiting for them.

In 1831 Michael Faraday first demonstrated electromagnetic induction. The spark that made electricity from magnetism possible.

AUG 30 is lit onchain.

1 piece carry this date, held by 1 wallet. Today 1 USDG is waiting for them.

BBN delivered the first IMP to UCLA on August 30, 1969. That box turned packet switching from theory into the first living node of what became the internet.

AUG 31 is lit onchain.

1 piece carry this date, held by 1 wallet. Today 1 USDG is waiting for them.

One day a year, this one is the only one that matters.

SEP 01 is lit onchain.

9 pieces carry this date, held by 8 wallets. Today 9 USDG is waiting for them.

Michael Rabin was born in 1931. His algorithms still quietly underpin much of what keeps crypto secure.

SEP 02 is lit onchain.

2 pieces carry this date, held by 2 wallets. Today 2 USDG is waiting for them.

In 1969 the first US ATM opened for business. Some conveniences arrive quietly and then never leave.

SEP 03 is lit onchain.

3 pieces carry this date, held by 2 wallets. Today 3 USDG is waiting for them.

In 1783 Britain signed the Treaty of Paris, formally recognizing American independence. Some agreements rewrite the map forever.

SEP 04 is dark onchain.

No piece carries this date. Nobody holds it. 2,781 pieces are still sealed, and the first to reveal this day owns it.

In 1998 Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporated Google. A garage project that quietly rewired how the world finds anything.

SEP 05 is lit onchain.

2 pieces carry this date, held by 2 wallets. Today 2 USDG is waiting for them.

In 1977 NASA launched Voyager 1. Nothing else has traveled so far from home.

SEP 06 is dark onchain.

No piece carries this date. Nobody holds it. 2,580 pieces are still sealed, and the first to reveal this day owns it.

In 1847 Henry David Thoreau left Walden after two years in the woods. Some experiments end exactly when they should.
